mentions.name: ApproveGate
mentions.description: A change management platform for production deployments that also helps teams produce and organize SOC 2 audit evidence.
mentions.problem: Teams lack a good process for managing production deployment changes and collecting SOC 2 audit evidence, a problem the author has experienced firsthand as a senior engineer.
mentions.audience: Leads and release managers involved in production deployments and compliance
mentions.source_excerpt:
